effect_protocol.chance_gate: task-clustered and parent-clustered 95% CI lower bounds for child_plus_transition accuracy must both exceed 0.5
effect_protocol.comparison: child_plus_transition minus child_code on identical pairs
effect_protocol.comparison_gate: task-clustered and parent-clustered paired 95% CI lower bounds must both exceed 0
effect_protocol.leave_one_task_out_gate: all task-macro delta point estimates must exceed 0
effect_protocol.secondary_outcome: immediate child score_public when both endpoints are finite and non-tied

estimand.candidate: first version of a distinct child kernel whose canonical parent edge_kind is fork
estimand.label: which fork child's kernel eventually attains the better finite best_private_score after applying score_is_max
estimand.pair: all unordered pairs of canonical fork children sharing the same exact parent node
estimand.task_unseen_primary: exclude every competition slug present in the frozen scorer train+dev pairs

integrity.code_conversion: for each ipynb, concatenate code-cell source in notebook order with two newlines; do not use outputs or markdown
integrity.credential_shaped_raw_files: identify by a non-printing path-only scanner and exclude whole files before any scientific parser reads them
integrity.exact_code_sha_overlap: exclude any parent or child whose converted code SHA overlaps scorer train, v11 frozen/extension, or prospective inventories

release.license: CC-BY-4.0 plus per-kernel licenses for raw notebooks
release.sha256_binding: record in a separate input manifest after download and before support aggregation

stages: S0 bind release SHA and schema without reading score values
S1 aggregate task-unseen canonical-fork structural and finite-outcome support
S2 only if S1 passes, download and sanitize raw notebooks, verify joins and exact-code overlap
S3 only if S2 passes, run the frozen scorer once and independent verification once
